mechanism: Cenobamate is a CYP3A4 and CYP2D6 inducer that decreases flecainide plasma concentrations, potentially reducing its antiarrhythmic efficacy; flecainide also has narrow therapeutic index and proarrhythmic potential.
action: Monitor flecainide levels and ECG closely; consider flecainide dose adjustment or alternative antiarrhythmic agent; therapeutic drug monitoring is recommended.
